content: F1 (severed feedback loop): record_yield.py and ingest_token_usage.py were the only writers to protocol_yield and discussion token totals. compute_agent_effectiveness still reads protocol_yield so findings_false_positive is permanently 0; v_token_efficiency view is permanently empty. briefings table has no outcome column, so ADR-0029's own stated falsification plan (compare deferrals against later trouble) cannot run. /retro retains a deletion prior with no measurement counterweight. F2 (third over-deletion): audit_calibration.py self-described as writing proposals to a human-approved queue and never editing a classifier surface - governance by ADR-0029's own test - yet was deleted as scaffolding; suggests sorting was by directory/line-count, not per-file. Also six ADRs (0013,0020,0022,0023,0024,0028) remain status:accepted with implementations deleted, and ADR-0029 supersedes is empty - a direct Principle 4 violation. F3: delete-and-see is valid for prose (symmetric cost, git recovery) but not for instrumented state (time series cannot be recovered retroactively); the two asset classes were priced identically.
